key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: The worldly life or lower world

ai.seo_question: What were the key ethical instructions given by the Prophet to his sons Hasan and Husayn in his final will?
ai.summary: This testament, delivered by the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) to his grandsons Hasan and Husayn, encapsulates the core Shia ethos of *Taqwa* (God-consciousness) and active resistance against injustice. It emphasizes that true detachment from the world (*Zuhd*) does not mean passivity, but rather engaging in the world while maintaining spiritual integrity, specifically by being a vocal opponent to tyrants and a steadfast supporter of the wronged. This directive serves as a foundational principle for the Imams' political and spiritual leadership throughout history.
